items.question: Who is the new CEO of CTS (NYSE: CTS) in 2026?
items.answer: CTS named Pratik Trivedi, its current COO, as CEO and President effective July 6, 2026. According to CTS, Trivedi will also join the Board when his CEO appointment becomes effective, succeeding long-time CEO Kieran O’Sullivan.

items.question: When will Pratik Trivedi officially become CEO and President of CTS (CTS)?
items.answer: Pratik Trivedi will become CEO and President of CTS on July 6, 2026. According to CTS, he will transition from his current COO role and simultaneously join the company’s Board of Directors on that effective date.
items.title: CTS names Trivedi CEO, President effective July 6 | CTS Stock News

items.question: What role will former CEO Kieran O’Sullivan have at CTS after July 2026?
items.answer: Kieran O’Sullivan will serve as Executive Chair and remain on the CTS Board after July 2026. According to CTS, he transitions to this position following 14 years as CEO, during which the company reports strengthened market position and higher enterprise value.

items.question: What experience does new CTS (CTS) CEO Pratik Trivedi bring to the role?
items.answer: Pratik Trivedi brings experience in high-growth technology companies, including CTS, Eaton and Cummins. items.answer: Pratik Trivedi, age 47, has been CTS’s Chief Operating Officer since December 2025 and joined as Senior Vice President in April 2024. items.question: What compensation will new CTS (CTS) CEO Pratik Trivedi receive?
items.answer: As President and CEO, Pratik Trivedi will receive a base salary of $675,000, a target annual cash bonus equal to 100% of salary for 2026 (prorated), and a new long-term incentive equity grant valued at $2,150,000, mostly in performance-based restricted stock units plus service-based units.

items.question: How are CTS (CTS) CEO Pratik Trivedi’s long-term incentives structured?
items.answer: His new long-term incentive award of $2,150,000 will be 60% performance-based restricted stock units and 40% service-based restricted stock units. The performance units generally vest based on CTS stock price performance over 2026–2028, while the service units vest in three equal annual installments after the grant date.

items.answer: Trivedi is expected to enter a change in control Severance Agreement with double-trigger severance.
